name: MP Police Emergency Control Room (Dial 100)
name_hindi: मध्य प्रदेश पुलिस आपातकालीन नियंत्रण कक्ष (डायल 100)
beneficiary: Victims and witnesses of crimes, public disturbances, and accidents
benefits: Immediate police deployment to maintain law and order and assist citizens.
eligibility: Any person in need of urgent police intervention
application_process: Dial 100 from any mobile or landline network.
